description: Expanded from the original resolved-config CLI-command deferral after the 2026-08-08 architecture review reproduced a systemic quick-restart replay defect. Quick restart restores raw selectors after derived state has already been resolved and refreshes only tuning_resolution; platform_key, phases, tuning flags and files, unified config, organization payload, dataframe tuning, resolved mode, seed, BenchmarkConfig, preview metadata, and execution context can therefore disagree. First characterize the full replay contract, then introduce typed RunRequest and immutable ResolvedRunPlan models with one resolver, migrate quick restart as the first vertical slice, and finally migrate interactive, direct CLI, dry-run, load-only, preview, and canonical-record paths. Decision cases: explicit current CLI input overrides saved preferences; saved configuration is resolved atomically; missing historical optional fields use documented compatibility defaults; missing or invalid current configuration fails closed and executes nothing; a missing saved seed must be surfaced as non-exact replay; environment discovery is captured once or explicitly revalidated. Guard rails: no per-field synchronization patch, no second mutable SimpleNamespace representation, no CLI flag rename, no preview/execution divergence, no removal of compatibility attributes until static and behavioral evidence shows no consumer, no broad run.py cleanup, preserve explicit dry-run phases and deterministic seeds, and measure setup/dispatch overhead before and after.
